title: Specified quotient transitions under proper system evaluations
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], finite-field datum $D$ with characteristic $p\ne\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and a proper morphism $f:X\to Y$ of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $K\in D(X,\widehat{\mathcal O}_E)$ be arbitrary and $n\in\mathbf N$ denote exponent $n+1$. Use the published reduction system $\mathcal R_X$, direct image $S_f$, identity-open extension $J$, completed restriction $U$, compact finite evaluation $c_n$, and ordinary direct-image evaluation mate $e_nS_f\cong Rf_{*,n}e_n$, all of [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. Put $M_!=S_fJ\mathcal R_XK$ and $M_*=S_f\mathcal R_XK$. Let $a_n:e_nUM_!\cong\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{!,n}^{(1,f)}K_n$ be restricted compactFiniteEvaluation, and $b_n:e_nUM_*\cong\operatorname{Res}_nRf_{*,n}K_n$ be the restricted ordinary evaluation mate followed by the actual reductionEvaluation. If $t_n$ is the transition of the completed strict tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], then $a_n t_n=a_{n+1}$ followed by the published compact transition [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and $b_n t_n=b_{n+1}$ followed by the published ordinary transition [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with composites interpreted as the commutative squares displayed in the Lean statement. No boundedness or constructibility of $K$ is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a single flat-term K-flat representative of K. The reductionModel clause identifies its whole reduction system and transitions with the quotient complexes and actual quotient chain maps.

Compute the system direct image using a simultaneous K-injective replacement. The specified finite evaluation mate preserves the quotient map; its comparison on coefficient restriction is the canonical restriction-of-scalars square. After exact completed restriction this is precisely the published ordinary transition and its associator.

For the compact system first insert exact identity-open extension. The open evaluation mate carries the quotient map to finite open extension; paste its restriction square with the proper restriction square. After completed restriction the composite is exactly the published compact transition. Localize these chain-map equations; no reduction map is asserted invertible.

theorem proper_system_evaluation_transitions
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := systemDirectEvaluation_isIso l E f n
    letI := systemDirectEvaluation_isIso l E f (n + 1)
    let M₁ := ((reduction l E X) ⋙
      (systemDerivedOpen l E (𝟙 X) ⋙ systemDirect l E f)).obj K
    let M₂ := ((reduction l E X) ⋙ systemDirect l E f).obj K
    let a := fun i : ℕ ↦
      (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y i).app M₁ ≪≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y i).mapIso
          ((compactFiniteEvaluation l E (Compactification.ofIsProper f) i).app K)
    let b₀ :=
      (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y n).app M₂ ≪≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).mapIso
          ((asIso (systemDirectEvaluation l E f n)).app ((reduction l E X).obj K) ≪≫
            (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).mapIso
                ((((models l E).system X).reductionEvaluation n).app K))
    let b₁ :=
      (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y (n + 1)).app M₂ ≪≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y (n + 1)).mapIso
          ((asIso (systemDirectEvaluation l E f (n + 1))).app ((reduction l E X).obj K) ≪≫
            (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage f
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E ((n + 1) + 1))).mapIso
                ((((models l E).system X).reductionEvaluation (n + 1)).app K))
    ((normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E Y D hl n.le_succ).app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y).obj M₁) ≫ (a n).hom =
      (a (n + 1)).hom ≫ sfCompactSupportTransition l E
        (Compactification.ofIsProper f) K n) ∧
    ((normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E Y D hl n.le_succ).app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y).obj M₂) ≫ b₀.hom =
      b₁.hom ≫ sfDirectImageTransition l E f K n)
